excluded_inventory_r1.cause: 242 collector read failures, node_repl exec context not found, including after and followup. Null catch attributes do not prove the page was hidden or the Game failed.
excluded_inventory_r1.replacement: inventory-r2 is a separate complete60-second capture, not a repaired/truncated r1.

scheduler_source_review.hypothesis: Fixed60Hz accumulator can render a zero-step callback, then run two updates before a later draw.1797callbacks/1730preparations/1798ticks is consistent with that pattern, while preserving simulation rate. It is not by itself proof of a scheduling bug.
scheduler_source_review.source_mechanism: resetClock anchors last to performance.now(); RAF callback uses its original timestamp; count=floor((acc+0.1667ms)/16.6667ms), with negative debt retained. Every admitted callback draws even count0. Next RAF is scheduled after awaited updates/draw finally.
scheduler_source_review.alternative: Async prepare/draw/host work can delay scheduling the next RAF. Atlas near60callback cadence and small prep/draw wall distributions weigh against sustained throughput saturation there, without proving a pure phase cause.
scheduler_source_review.existing_fields: RAF time, submission start/end/callback_end, frame, outcome,new_snapshot and cumulative preparation/step counters are recorded; current rows do not expose exact per-callback step/accumulator state.
scheduler_source_review.minimal_diagnostic: A separate opt-in bounded passive row can retain existing onWake elapsed_ms/steps plus accumulator before/after,due/count/lost and reset/generation markers, joined to the unchanged RAF token. Existing profiler can record tickOnce coalescing. Do not alter clock, render order, fixedstep policy or create frames/ticks.

limits: Current main source98a9 and earlier source32fd differ; these runs are not strict engine A/B and no cross-version speedup is inferred.
Battle uses the explicitly recorded QA wrapper fc079 around the current98a9 source, not an identical production-main artifact.
Root reported an offline Lab scan may just have been finishing before idle. External load was not independently quantified.
Travel includes the recorded camera/projection transitions. It is not an exact replay of the earlier32fd route.
Inventory-r1 lost the CUA exec context. Null catch attributes do not prove the page was hidden or the game feed failed; the whole60s r2 replaces it for performance review.
Prospective source pins and recorded time order agree on disk; offline hashes alone cannot independently prove execution history.
Native scene screenshots/input require human review. This analysis does not manufacture private world observations or behavior acceptance.

Freshness failures are retained: town after469.2ms and battle after433.8ms exceed250ms boundary tolerance despite observed internal cadence. No chosen subwindow or later cost-followup replaces those original endpoints.

Travel remains a known failure:22UI-assets skips and2dropped steps plus coverage holes; its later faster tail does not rescue the whole window. No asset ID or Lua/GPU cause can be inferred from these completion-only rows.

No same-row playerPerformance, broker/decoded-image, UI GPU metrics or CPU stage profile was collected; backend main and completion timing are available. Do not join the earlier32fd profiler or another page epoch as if it were same-state evidence.
All releaseReady flags remainfalse and analyzer scene behavior unverified. Cadence pass is not pixel correctness, GPU/OS scanout, entire-game release readiness, no-GC or no-leak proof.
